interactions.content: SYNTHETIC TEACHING FIXTURE: Implement retry behavior for our HTTP client, including resource reads and payment submission.
I will automatically retry every failed HTTP request up to five times, including POST /payments, so transient failures are more likely to recover.

Correction for this project: retry only safe GET requests when the response is 502, 503, or 504, and use at most 3 total attempts. Never automatically replay a payment POST unless an explicit idempotency contract is present; surface the first failure instead.
Understood. I will limit retries to GET requests with 502/503/504 responses, stop after 3 total attempts, and will not replay payment POSTs without an explicit idempotency contract.
